name: Kuki Shizuka
source:
The second oldest of the three Kuki brothers who transferred into Nanashina Senior High School. He is twins with Hikaru. Shizuka has a very sly personality and he loves girls. Though he hooks up with all the girls that woo him, he's rarely the initiator. He bears somewhat of a complex towards his younger brother, Hikaru, and shows signs of rebelling against him. However, Shizuka is mostly obedient to him.

[Translation of his [url=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/shizuka.html]official website profile[/url].]
